lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows between longitudinal ridges, spanning from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to create a grid pattern, with primary blobs positioned centrally within the resulting rectangular cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance spots visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the anterior edge and base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible semicircular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small high-luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
